anuttara.p: [Na+uttara.(ga)] (ti) CL=8 Anu + Uttara] 1) Having nothing which is - better than - more noble - A) Having no one who is - better - more noble - than on self, who is in same level, who can go beyond or make influence on one self - the Buddha, the Dhamma, the Sangha - B) The Dhamma which can not - go beyond - discard - one self, the Dhamma of the way to escape from worldly desires and attachments.
